categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Resolution of the fine case through payment realization, advancing the softgoal to maximize timely fine revenue and helping minimize administrative and enforcement cost, judged against time-to-closure indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=12 in the goal model. Supported by frequent narrative variants like V0002 and V0007 showing direct payment after fine creation.

categories.name: Merged case resolution
categories.description: Resolution of cases through merged enforcement paths (Task 13+20), helping maximize timely fine revenue while hurting administrative cost and preserving due process, judged against average case closure time indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=13. Evidenced in various credit collection and closure pathways in the event log.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Resolution through an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture, helping preserve offender due-process rights while impacting revenue and enforcement costs, evaluated against Prefecture appeal timing indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=14. Supported by narrative traces containing appeal insertion, sending, and receiving results from the Prefecture (e.g., V0008, V0057).

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Resolution through a judicial appeal to the Judge, making a strong positive contribution to preserving offender due-process rights while hurting administrative costs, judged against Judge appeal timing indicators.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative id=19. Supported by narrative variants showing direct or subsequent judge appeal activities (e.g., V0103, V0176).
